    :param np_image: The image as a NumPy array on which face restoration is attempted.

    if gfpgan_model.gfpgan_face_restorer is None:
        logger.warning("GFPGAN face restorer not set up. Returning original image.")
        return np_image

    restored_image = gfpgan_model.gfpgan_face_restorer.restore(np_image)
    return restored_image
